gap: No result ChatGPT got states that, today (2026-11-17), both large built-in-pump AlorAirs are listed "Out of Stock" on alorair.com: the HDi90 (Built-in Pump) at $1,032.39, its WiFi version at $895.38, and the Galaxy 85P at $899.11. The in-stock unit with the same specs is the Abestorm Guardian SNS90 at $802.98 on abestorm.com: 90 pints/day AHAM, 14.7 ft drain height, 2,600 sq ft, COP 2.69 L/kWh.
standout_why: I compared against the cited crawlspacedehumidifiers.org/with-pump page, the cited dehumidifierverdict.com page, and ChatGPT's own cards. crawlspacedehumidifiers.org lists the SNS90 at a $746 sale price and the HDi90 at $1,147 (Sylvane), but it says nothing about stock and has no alorair.com prices. dehumidifierverdict.com does not list the SNS90 at all, and it calls the gravity-drain HD55 'no pump' with prices only as '~$'. ChatGPT's two answers made the HDi90 their best pick for large crawl spaces, at '$1,147 approx.' and '$1,032.39', without noting that it can't be bought from the maker today. ChatGPT also quoted the HD55P at '$700 approx.', but alorair.com charges $583.28. I could not open the cited crawlclimate.com page (TLS certificate error).
decides: For crawl spaces over about 1,500 sq ft, the pick has to change. The HDi90 (ChatGPT's choice) and the Galaxy 85P (our current large pick) both show 'Out of Stock' on alorair.com. The Abestorm SNS90 is available, costs $229.41 less than the HDi90 Built-in Pump ($1,032.39 - $802.98), and lists the same AHAM rating, drain height, coverage, COP, dimensions and dBA. It loses on warranty: crawlspacedehumidifiers.org gives it 1 year full plus 5 years on components, against AlorAir's 6-year limited with 2 years full. For under 1,300 sq ft, the HD55P stays the pick at $583.28. The Abestorm SNS65 costs $97.71 more ($680.99), and the HDi65S is $16.53 cheaper ($566.75), but alorair.com lists 'Pump Draining' for the HDi65S without saying the pump is built in. For under 1,000 sq ft, the Abestorm SN35P is $349.58 against $431.69 for the AlorAir HD35P and $438.92 for our HD35P WiFi; it shares the HD35P's 15.2×11.2×11.4 in body and 19.6 ft pump hose.
